name: Carvedilol
class: Non-selective beta blocker with alpha-blocking activity
mechanism: β1, β2, and α1 antagonist providing vasodilation and reduced cardiac workload
dosing: Heart failure: start 3.125mg BD, titrate slowly to max 25-50mg BD. Hypertension: 12.5-50mg daily
contraindications: Severe heart failure decompensation, asthma, heart block, severe hepatic impairment
interactions: Digoxin (↑ levels), insulin (masks hypoglycaemia), calcium channel blockers
monitoring: Heart rate, blood pressure, signs of heart failure worsening, hepatic function
pregnancy: Limited data - use only if benefit outweighs risk
clinicalPearls: Evidence-based for heart failure. Start low, go slow with careful titration
